==About me==

I started reading WoT around 2000. I've read a few fantasy novel series before that, but the amount of books already written for the series at that time kept me from getting into it. Having finished the few other books I had, and an upcoming long trip finally got me into the EotW, and am I glad it did. I'd planned for EotW to last me a couple of weeks, three days later I was looking for TGH. I ended up buying all the books while on the trip, and had to lug them all back home afterwards. 

As to how I came here. Well, I like reading about historic battles on wikipedia occasionally,; and being an avid reader of Star Wars as well, I also like reading through Wookieepedia. Then TGS came around, and this place became a place to brush up on stuff I forgot throughout the series without having to go through the books one by one. But some information here were not quite as comprehensive as I'd hoped, and some things I couldn't find, which led me to start editing things myself. 

As I said, I like reading battles, so that's where I started, and I plan to work through them one by one to make what improvements I can. Other edits will come as I come across them, and also depending on what books I have in hand at any one time. I'm still new here though, so if there's anything I write you think you can improve on, especially links and categories and all that stuff, by all means go for your life and I thank you for your efforts.
